name: werkmeister
description: Multi-feature concurrent development orchestrator CLI tool
//files: dist/ is gitignored build output, and npm drops gitignored paths unless an explicit list opts them back in. That opt-in is indiscriminate, so the negations below keep out files an older CLI generated into a maintainer's checkout — above all tmp/kubeconfig, which held live cluster credentials. Current versions generate under ~/.werkmeister/infra, so these only guard stale local files at pack time.

scripts.prepack: cd ../../packages/werkmeister-vscode && pnpm run build && pnpm run package --out ../../apps/cli/dist/sandbox-workspaces.vsix

//prepack: Ships the VS Code extension in the tarball for `sandbox setup` to install. Pack-time only, never `build`, so a checkout has no dist/*.vsix and setup never installs a dev's local build.
//dependencies: Everything else is bundled by esbuild.mjs — see its docstring. dockerode stays external because its ssh2 -> cpu-features requires must be allowed to fail into a pure-JS fallback, and ESM output turns an unresolved require into a shim that throws instead. The Agent SDK is external too, because it locates its bundled Claude Code binary by its own package path. It is optional (SW-73): only `detect --assist` loads it, and that command prints an install hint when it is absent.
